scope: Word real pagination (W-A21) verified on the real 1.2MB proposal and synthetic split cases
algorithm: web/src/app/core/office/word-paginate.ts: paginateBlocks() splits paragraphs and table rows by measured DOM height (2-pass), content height 864px = page 1056px minus 2x96px padding; explicit w:br type=page forces a new page

footerPageField.before: Footer used a complex PAGE field (fldChar begin/instrText PAGE/fldChar separate/result 20/end); parser only checked w:fldSimple and rendered the stale cached result '20' on every page
footerPageField.after: collectFieldText() detects both w:fldSimple and complex PAGE fields, marks hasPageNumber, skips cached field results, and each page renders page.index + 1

new: word paginate table rows 12 pages covering 200 rows

limitations: Nested table is flattened inside its parent cell for display (XML preserved)
TOC page numbers remain cached text (no TOC page-number recompute engine)
Ink strokes store the page index at draw time; heavy edits that reflow pages can move them
Floating images/text boxes are not page-aware
